metadata.question: Were there fires visible in a 50 mile radius around (latitude: 34.498828, longitude: -112.246886) between June 20, 2017 and June 30, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (lat: 34.498828, lon: -112.246886) with 50 mile radius buffer - Date range: June 20, 2017 to June 30, 2017 - Dataset: Use MODIS burned area or thermal anomaly data (e.g., MODIS MCD64A1 for burned area, or FIRMS for fire detections) - Alternative: Landsat 8 with thermal/spectral analysis for fire signatures 2. Masking strategy: - Fire detection: No cloud masking needed—we're looking for fire signals - Use MODIS thermal anomalies or burned area products - Look for active fires or recent burn scars in the time window 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero (B): Images exist, processed, but NO fires detected (fire pixels = 0) - C1: No imagery available for the date/location - C2: Images exist but 0 valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Fires ARE visible (fire pixel count > 0) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry: 50 mile radius around the point const lat = 34.498828; const lon = -112.246886; const radiusMiles = 50; const radiusMeters = radiusMiles * 1609.34; // Convert miles to meters const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]); const aoi = point.buffer(radiusMeters); // 2. Define date range: June 20, 2017 to June 30, 2017 const startDate = '2017-06-20'; const endDate = '2017-06-30'; // 3. Load MODIS Thermal Anomalies (FIRMS data via MCD14ML) // This dataset contains active fire detections const firmsCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(aoi); const firmsSize = await firmsCollection.size().getInfo(); print(`MODIS FIRMS Images: ${firmsSize}`); if (firmsSize === 0) { // Fallback to MODIS Burned Area MCD64A1 const burnedAreaCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(aoi); const baSize = await burnedAreaCollection.size().getInfo(); print(`MODIS Burned Area Images: ${baSize}`); if (baSize === 0) { print('No fire data available for the date/location.'); print('C1'); return; } // Process burned area data const burnedAreaImg = burnedAreaCollection.first(); const burnDate = burnedAreaImg.select('BurnDate'); const validPixels = await burnDate.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); print(`Burned Area Valid Pixels: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === 0 || validPixels === null) { print('No valid burned area pixels detected.'); print('B'); return; } // Count pixels with burn dates in June 2017 const firePixels = await burnDate .gt(0) // Burn date > 0 indicates a fire .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('BurnDate').getInfo(); print(`Fire Pixels (Burned Area): ${firePixels}`); if (firePixels === null || firePixels === 0) { print('No fires detected in burned area data.'); print('B'); } else { print(`Fires detected: ${firePixels} pixels`); print('A'); } } else { // Process FIRMS active fire data const firmsImg = firmsCollection.first(); const confidence = firmsImg.select('confidence'); // Count high-confidence fire detections (confidence > 50) const firePixels = await confidence .gt(50) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('confidence').getInfo(); print(`FIRMS High-Confidence Fire Pixels: ${firePixels}`); if (firePixels === null || firePixels === 0) { print('No active fires detected (FIRMS).'); print('B'); } else { print(`Active fires detected: ${firePixels} pixels`); print('A'); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
